name: What factors influence the potential rental income of a vacation property?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the potential rental income of a vacation property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Potential rental income is influenced by factors such as property size and amenities, location, seasonal demand, and local nightly rates. Proximity to popular attractions, beaches, or business centers in South Florida can significantly boost demand. The condition and appeal of the property, including modern furnishings and desirable features, also play a key role in attracting guests and commanding higher rates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Factors influencing rental income include property size, amenities, location, seasonal demand, and local nightly rates.
